name: fun-harness
displayName: Fun Harness AI 研发流程
description: 在 VS Code 内把 AI 编程组织成可控的研发流水线：需求→设计→测试→任务拆解→开发→合并，每步专属 Agent + 独立 Git Worktree + 多阶段安全合并保护。支持 Copilot / Claude Code / Trae / Qodo 等多 Provider。

commands.title: Fun Harness AI 研发流程

fun-harness-des.description: Fun harness 设计生成 Agent

fun-harness-req.description: Fun harness 需求生成 Agent

fun-harness-tsk.description: Fun harness 任务拆解 Agent

fun-harness-tcs.description: Fun harness 测试用例 Agent

fun-harness-dev.description: Fun harness 代码生成 Agent

scripts.package:local: npm run clean:vsix && npm run compile && vsce package --allow-missing-repository --allow-star-activation -o "fun-harness-$(node -p "require('./package.json').version")-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S).vsix"
scripts.changelog:check: node -e "const v=require('./package.json').version,c=require('fs').readFileSync('CHANGELOG.md','utf8');if(!c.includes('## ['+v+']')){console.error('\u274c CHANGELOG.md 缺少 ## ['+v+'] 小节，请先补写本次发布的更新日志');process.exit(1)}console.log('\u2705 CHANGELOG.md 已包含 '+v+' 小节')"
scripts.release:patch: npm run changelog:check && npm version patch -m "release: v%s"
scripts.release:minor: npm run changelog:check && npm version minor -m "release: v%s"
